## Summary

Provide a brief description of the proposed feature.

## Problem or Motivation

Describe the problem this feature would solve.

## Proposed Solution

Explain how you envision the feature working.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions you have considered.

## Compatibility

Does this change affect existing installations or behavior?

- [ ] No impact on existing functionality
- [ ] May introduce breaking changes
- [ ] Requires additional configuration
- [ ] Unsure

## Additional Information

Include any relevant examples, references,
screenshots, or implementation considerations.
